# Get Online SA

> Website design for small businesses in South Africa, in Afrikaans and English. We build a free demo of your website first, you look, and you only pay if you want it. Fixed prices, standard websites in 48 hours.

Based in Robertson, Western Cape. Built and run by Francois Conradie (sole proprietor, trading as Get Online SA). Serves Robertson, McGregor, Montagu, Bonnievale, Ashton, Worcester and anywhere in South Africa.

## Pages
- [English](https://getonlinesa.co.za/): prices, how it works, examples, order form, contact form, FAQ, terms, privacy
- [Afrikaans](https://getonlinesa.co.za/af/): dieselfde inhoud in Afrikaans
- [Example website](https://getonlinesa.co.za/voorbeeld/): a complete example for a made-up plumber

## Prices (once-off, no VAT)
- Starter, one page, ready in 48 hours: R2 500 (normal price R3 500)
- Standard, up to five pages, Google Business Profile clean-up and basic local search set-up, ready in 48 hours: R4 500 (normal R5 600)
- Plus, up to 10 pages and one interactive feature, ready in 5 to 7 working days: R8 500 (normal R10 000)
- Custom, larger or interactive websites: from R15 000 by written quote
- Special prices apply to orders up to and including 28 February 2027
- Extras: Google pack R950; care plan R350 a month or R3 500 a year
- Payment: 50% deposit, balance when you approve the site. Hosting free for 12 months. Domain (.co.za) is registered in your name, roughly R50 to R150 a year.
